definitions.gloss: cheese fondue (a Swiss dish of melted cheese eaten communally with bread, vegetables, etc.)
definitions.explanation: A communal Swiss/French dish in which cheese is melted in a small pot (typically with white wine and seasonings) and kept warm at the table. Diners use long forks to dip pieces of bread, boiled potatoes, vegetables, or sausage into the molten cheese. In Japan, チーズフォンデュ is a popular dinner-party and restaurant dish, especially in winter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今夜|こんや}→今夜：01411_konya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧チーズフォンデュ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{熱|あつ}い→熱い：09888_atsui⟧チーズフォンデュにつけて⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I dip bread into the hot cheese fondue and eat it.
I bought a special pot for making cheese fondue at home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧チーズフォンデュ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{囲|かこ}み→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: In winter, I love sitting around a cheese fondue with my family and slowly enjoying the meal together.

notes:
チーズフォンデュ is a loanword based on French "fondue (au fromage)," referring to the Swiss/French communal dish of melted cheese into which diners dip bites of bread or vegetables. In Japan it is associated especially with romantic dinners, winter parties, and trendy restaurants.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- チーズフォンデュ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make / decide on cheese fondue
- チーズフォンデュ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make cheese fondue
- チーズフォンデュにつける / ⟦つけて→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to dip (something) into cheese fondue and eat it
- チーズフォンデュ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧: cheese fondue pot
- チーズフォンデュ⟦{専用|せんよう}→専用：12385_senyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧: special pot for cheese fondue

RELATED WORDS:
- フォンデュ: fondue (the general term, can also refer to chocolate fondue, etc.)
- チョコフォンデュ / ⟦チョコレート→チョコレート：05183_chokoreeto⟧フォンデュ: chocolate fondue
- ⟦{鍋|なべ}{料理|りょうり}→鍋料理：19952_naberyouri⟧: hot-pot dish (a broader Japanese category that fondue is felt to belong to)
- ラクレット: raclette (a related cheese-melting dish from the same region)
- ⟦{溶|と}ける→溶ける：02302_tokeru⟧⟦チーズ→チーズ：00026_chiizu⟧: melting cheese (often sold for fondue or pizza)

USAGE:
- The standard verb for what diners do with the fondue is ⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ ("to dip") combined with ⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: ⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧チーズフォンデュ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{付|つ}けて→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧.
- Although technically of Swiss origin, in Japan chocolate fondue (チョコフォンデュ) is so popular at dessert buffets that フォンデュ on its own is sometimes ambiguous; using the full term チーズフォンデュ avoids confusion.
